scripts.benchmark: bun run build && bun run scripts/benchmark.ts
scripts.build: bun run check:data && bun run build:app
scripts.build:app: wrangler types --include-runtime false && astro check && astro build
scripts.check:data: bun run types:data && ./node_modules/@typescript/native/bin/tsc --noEmit --project workers/hn-data/tsconfig.json && wrangler deploy -c workers/hn-data/wrangler.jsonc --dry-run
scripts.deploy: bun run deploy:data && bun run build:app && wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:data: bun run check:data && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote -c workers/hn-data/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler deploy -c workers/hn-data/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.typecheck: wrangler types --include-runtime false && bun run types:data && astro check && ./node_modules/@typescript/native/bin/tsc --noEmit --project tsconfig.native.json && ./node_modules/@typescript/native/bin/tsc --noEmit --project workers/hn-data/tsconfig.json
